scope: Metadata for the 12 stations represented in the AirBench Beijing benchmark (observation grid 2013-03-01 through 2017-02-28).

sources.title: Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality
sources.notes: The original UCI schema contains station names but no station_code, longitude, latitude, district, or elevation fields.

sources.authority: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China
sources.title: National Ambient Air Monitoring Network Setting Plan (2012), Table 3
sources.notes: Lists Beijing's 12 national-network sites and identifies Dingling as the control/reference site.

sources.authority: Peer-reviewed article using China Environmental Monitoring Center observations
sources.title: Comparison of Hourly PM2.5 Observations Between Urban and Suburban Areas in Beijing, China
sources.notes: Table 1 gives codes 1001-1012, names, and CEMC urban/suburban categories for observations beginning in March 2013. The A suffix used in AirBench follows the national station mapping convention.

sources.authority: Peer-reviewed article using Beijing's national monitoring network
sources.title: Air Quality of Beijing and Impacts of the New Ambient Air Quality Standard
sources.notes: Distinguishes eight urban, three suburban, and one background station and states that Dingling is excluded from the city API calculation.

sources.title: Circulation-regulated impacts of aerosol pollution on urban heat island in Beijing, Table S2
sources.notes: Table S2 lists all 12 CNEMC station IDs and coordinates, including 1012A Gucheng at 116.225 E, 39.9279 N. It is not a surveyed historical site-location record for the full benchmark period.

sources.title: DataV Quick Start, 2017 national station coordinate mapping example
sources.notes: Secondary corroboration only. The document explicitly prints the first Beijing entries rather than serving as the sole source for all 12 rows.

sources.title: datasets/Beijing.csv enrichment
sources.notes: These are benchmark-reproduction coordinates, not fields from UCI. Gucheng longitude 116.184 conflicts with the commonly published 1012A registry longitude 116.225.

sources.authority: Peer-reviewed article using Beijing monitoring-center observations
sources.title: Changing weekend effects of air pollutants in Beijing under 2020 COVID-19 lockdown controls, Table 1
sources.notes: Later-period station location descriptions used only to cross-check site identity (for example Dongcheng Environmental Protection Bureau and Shijingshan Environmental Protection Bureau); not evidence of unchanged 2013-2017 coordinates.

sources.title: Beijing district boundary GeoJSON
sources.method: EPSG:4326 point-in-polygon using the AirBench benchmark longitude/latitude. Derived values are a coordinate QA diagnostic, not a historical boundary claim.

sources.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Global 30 m Digital Elevation Model), COG tiles via AWS Open Data
sources.notes: Anonymous 1-degree COG tiles at 30 m posting, EPSG:4326. Tiles Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N39_00_E116_00_DEM and Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N40_00_E116_00_DEM cover all 12 stations. Sampled with nearest-neighbour at the benchmark coordinates by scripts/ingest/fetch_dem.py. GLO-30 vertical accuracy is specified as better than 4 m LE90 over low-slope terrain.

field_semantics.longitude_latitude: Values already present in datasets/Beijing.csv; retained exactly so existing benchmark cases remain reproducible.
field_semantics.registry_longitude_latitude: Secondary national station-registry mapping values. They are not asserted to be surveyed physical-site coordinates valid throughout 2013-2017.
field_semantics.site_district: District associated with the named physical monitoring site, cross-checked against published station location descriptions and official district codes.
field_semantics.coordinate_district: District produced by point-in-polygon from the benchmark coordinates against a current boundary snapshot.
field_semantics.benchmark_group: AirBench-specific partition from domains/Beijing/stations.py; it is not an official station class.
field_semantics.observation_grid: First and last hourly row timestamps in the benchmark, not commissioning/decommissioning dates.
field_semantics.terrain_elevation: Ground-surface elevation sampled from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 at the benchmark coordinate. This is TERRAIN height, not station (sampling-inlet) elevation: it excludes the inlet height above ground (typically 3-15 m at rooftop sites) and inherits any error in the recorded coordinate, whose historical validity is unverified (see location_history_status). Suitable for terrain analysis (relief, basin effects, terrain-aware interpolation); not a metrological station elevation.

known_limitations: The UCI release does not publish codes, coordinates, addresses, instrument models, inlet heights, elevations, or relocation history.
The benchmark coordinates disagree with physical-site district identity for Wanshouxigong and Dongsi.
The AirBench Gucheng longitude (116.184) differs from the common 1012A registry mapping (116.225). Both are retained rather than silently choosing one.
No authoritative period-specific station elevation or relocation record was located; station_elevation_m is intentionally empty.
Current web maps or coordinates must not be presented as unchanged historical locations for 2013-2017.
terrain_elevation_m is a DEM-derived ground elevation at the recorded coordinate and must not be substituted for station_elevation_m, which remains unverified for 2013-2017.
